scope: Targeted research-only diagnosis: treat pressure-recovery attenuation A as an extra unknown and impose extrapolated physical-gap derivative h_x=0 at the prescribed cavity end. This is a MODIFIED closure-parameter selection, not the unchanged fixed-A model.
equationCount: For each A the original N+2 mixed BIE/free-boundary calculation is solved. The outer scalar equation h_x(end;A)=0 determines the extra unknown A. Existing geometry/admission requirements are retained.

metrics.pressureNote: Pressure residual uses a local five-point derivative of solved total potential within each boundary region (fewer points if needed), with one-sided stencils at detachment and closure. It compares to an imposed BC, not an experiment.
